index_support: Reviewed train split only; validation and test never become exemplars.
selection: Validation named macro recall, then lower cross entropy; exact ties retain first candidate. Compare selected retrieval against frozen linear baseline by same validation criteria; development reports follow selection.
reference_scope: DINOv2 provides both k-NN and linear evaluation; our classwise pooling experiment is implemented locally in Rust and is not a reproduction of its ImageNet benchmark.
